package.name: Modern Life Sim
package.description: A modern life sim in its own Home tab: a town on a clock, a job, rent and needs, and a cast drawn from your character cards whose relationships grow scene by scene, with a visual-novel narrator for the scenes that matter. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Life Sim.
